question: Which deities are invoked to protect the head and forehead?
premises: The sacred syllable om opens the invocation.
The yakshini is asked to protect the speaker's head.
The yaksha maiden is asked to protect the forehead.
inference: Protection of the head and forehead is sought from the yakshini and the yaksha maiden.
plain_english: Om. May the yakshini protect my head, and may the yaksha maiden protect my forehead.
